definitions.full: H4928. mishmaath [ מִשְׁמַ֫עַת ] noun feminine obedient band, body of subjects ; — only suffix: 1 probably = body-guard , as especially bound to obedience, מִשְׁמַעְתּ֑ךָ 1Sam 22:14 captain over thy guard (Ew Be Ch Dr Bu Now), compare תּוֺ - 2Sam 23:23 = 1Chr 11:25 . 2 תָּם - Isa 11:14 the sons of Ammon (shall be) their subjects (|| מוֺאָב ; יָדָם מִשְׁלוֺחַ ; compare משמעת MI 28 ). שׁמץ (√ of following; compare Late Hebrew שֵׁמֶץ accusation (or suspicion) ; Thes compare Arabic speak rapidly (and indistinctly) ( †am Frey); but dubious; rapidity seems main idea; — and שׁ = ?).
